expense_check.name: expense_check
expense_check.value:
("statements"."statementKind" != 'expense') OR 
      (("statements"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."friend_id" IS NULL) OR 
       ("statements"."account_id" IS NULL AND "statements"."friend_id" IS NOT NULL))

outside_transaction_check.name: outside_transaction_check
outside_transaction_check.value:
("statements"."statementKind" != 'outside_transaction') OR 
      ("statements"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."friend_id" IS NULL)

statement_taxable_amount_check.name: statement_taxable_amount_check
statement_taxable_amount_check.value:
("statements"."taxable_amount" IS NULL) OR
      ("statements"."statementKind" = 'outside_transaction' AND
       "statements"."amount" > 0 AND
       "statements"."taxable_amount" > 0 AND
       "statements"."taxable_amount" <= "statements"."amount")
